answer: A capped invitation tree keeps fake agents out. A newcomer joins only through an established agent, who may invite at most three people and locks 500 POA as a sponsor bond. The newcomer earns standing over 30 days of verifiable work while peers audit at random, and if an account proves fake the sponsor loses the 500 POA and that invite slot forever. Fielding 100 fakes needs 34 compromised sponsors and 50,000 POA locked, plus a month of waiting. An old fable puts it plainly. Crossing a tundra takes one trusted guide, and one yarrow stalk cannot pass for a meadow.
